text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down the hallway 
with T.M. Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: W-What is the meaning of this?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My smooth, supple skin, praised as the 
reincarnation of Cleopatra's very own—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why... ah! Look how terribly it has been 
vandalized!
choice_data_list: Doesn't seem any different from usual...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about! Look closely 
at my right index finger!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her outstretched right hand, 
her fingertips do indeed appear slightly 
chapped, but—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Do you see now? I can't even 
begin to express how much I regret this 
blunder...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even a slight skin breakout was a massive 
crisis to her, and T.M. Opera O was 
utterly devastated...
